name: code-enhance
description: Run five explicit read-only code review specialties plus Volcano Ark text embedding and semantic repository indexing.

interface.shortDescription: Review, embed, index, and semantically search code.
interface.longDescription: Review repositories through five explicit, strictly read-only specialties, or explicitly send selected safe text to Volcano Ark Coding Plan for JSON embeddings and an external incremental semantic code index. The remote embedding skills remain isolated from the review Finder and Validator workflows.
capabilities: Volcano Ark text and code embeddings
Incremental semantic repository indexing and search
defaultPrompt: Use $code-enhance:embed and $code-enhance:index to embed selected code and semantically search this repository.
Use $code-enhance:beautify, $code-enhance:simplify, and $code-enhance:standardize to review current changes.
Use $code-enhance:design and $code-enhance:security to review current changes for design boundaries and security risks.
